brief:
Intelligence chiefs from Egypt, Turkey, and Qatar have called for an immediate end to ongoing occupation violations in Gaza, Shehab Wire reported. The three nations' spy agency heads made the demand as Israeli military operations in the enclave continue.

The statement marks a coordinated regional response to the situation on the ground, with the three governments pressing for cessation of what they characterize as systematic breaches of international norms in the Palestinian territory.
dek: Intelligence chiefs from Egypt, Turkey, and Qatar have called for an immediate end to ongoing occupation violations in Gaza, Shehab Wire reported.
title: Egypt, Turkey, Qatar demand halt to Gaza occupation violations
